## Business Problem / Component
Which BP (BP1-BP6) or shared `src/` module does this affect?

## Problem this solves
What real gap or limitation does this address? (Reference a MODEL_CARD.md/RULE_CARD.md Caveats section or a LESSONS_LEARNED_APPLIED.md entry if applicable.)

## Proposed approach
Concrete description of the change -- not just "it would be nice if".

## Alternatives considered
What else was considered and why this approach is preferred.

## Zero-fabrication / regulatory impact
Does this feature touch any figure that must stay real-computed-only (no synthetic placeholder output, Section 7B)? Does it touch a regulatory-mapped component (Section 6 of the master plan)?
